export: HDOT SHACA (State of Hawaii Advanced Crash Analysis) crash export, by request to HDOT Highways Division, Traffic Safety Section
spec: No public column list found (searched hidot.hawaii.gov and HDOT's ArcGIS/Socrata orgs, 2026-11-08). Field names below are the open HDOT_Crash_Layer's (https://services.arcgis.com/HQ0xoN0EzDPBOEci/arcgis/rest/services/HDOT_Crash/FeatureServer/0) where it has the field; the rest are what CrashIQ needs and must be confirmed on one sample export.
unit: one row per crash (the open layer); person/vehicle tables not documented

map.collision_id: report number: NOT in the open layer; required in the export
map.datetime: crash date and time: NOT in the open layer (crash_year only); required
map.lat: gps_latitude (0,0 and the county default point 21.480852,-157.923130 for HON mean no point)
map.primary_road: route / road name: NOT in the open layer; the fatal entry layer has Route, RoadName
map.secondary_road: cross street: not in any open layer
map.milepost: milepost: fatal entry layer only (milepost, RteOffset, dirn, measunit)
map.county_code: county: HON=15003, HAW=15001, MAU=15009 (incl. Kalawao 15005 by location), KAU=15007
map.jurisdiction: prim_jurisdict: S=state, C=county, then functional-class digit and U/R (urban/rural); S1x = interstate (is_freeway)
map.severity: NOT in the open layer as KABCO; crashseveritymajorinjury is one flag (1 = major injury, meaning undocumented). Export must give the most severe injury per crash (K/A/B/C/O)
map.killed: not in the open layer (FatalCrash.Total_Fatalities for fatal crashes)
map.collision_type: not in the open layer (crashactions holds numeric action codes, list not published)
